user.title: Connect Track Things
user.description: Sign in to one Track Things account. HTTPS is required; enable local HTTP only for a development backend on your local network.

workspace.title: Select workspace
workspace.description: Choose the workspace accessible to this account.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in with the original account to restore access to the configured workspace.

error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTPS backend URL without credentials, query, or fragment. Local HTTP requires explicit opt-in.
error.invalid_auth: The credentials were rejected. Please try again.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Track Things. Try again later.
error.wrong_account: Sign in with the account originally used for this integration.
error.workspace_unavailable: This account no longer has access to the configured workspace. Restore access and try again.

abort.already_configured: This backend, account, and workspace are already configured.
abort.no_workspaces: This account has no accessible workspaces.
